story.title: IT Body NITES Urges India's Labour Ministry to Mandate Work From Home for IT Workers Amid Oil Price Surge
story.summary: The Nascent Information Technology Employees Senate (NITES) has formally urged India's Ministry of Labour and Employment to issue an advisory mandating work-from-home arrangements for IT workers wherever operationally feasible, citing rising fuel costs and the broader economic burden on tech employees commuting to offices. The request comes as oil prices surge amid regional geopolitical tensions, placing renewed pressure on Indian IT workers' disposable income. NITES argues that India's IT sector has already demonstrated its ability to operate effectively remotely and that a formal advisory would provide legal backing for employees to request flexible arrangements.
